description: Statutory edges: salvia, the least-used of the three offences fixed by KRS 218A.276(1); the non-ordinary court level, since the recorded venue says District Court only 'ordinarily'; completion of treatment rather than probation or sentence; and the once-only voiding edge answered at the permitted edge. Dates are absent, not synthesized. Court identity and protected fields stay blank.

boundaryUnderTest: KRS 218A.276(1) offence-list edge: salvia (KRS 218A.1451), the third and narrowest member of the fixed list, alongside marijuana (KRS 218A.1422) and synthetic drugs (KRS 218A.1430).

Venue edge: the recorded venue is 'the court of conviction, ordinarily District Court'. This fixture takes the non-ordinary Circuit Court branch so that nothing is prefilled from the word 'ordinarily'.
KRS 218A.276(8) completion branch: treatment, rather than probation or the sentence itself.
Once-only edge: no prior voiding under KRS 218A.276.
Waiting period edge: the registry records no waiting period independent of completion, so no elapsed-time value is set.

attachments: Proof of completion of treatment (participant obtains; LegalEase does not inspect it; the statute does not require it to be filed)
